title: TenantContext
description: The canonical request-scoped tenant + actor context. tenant_id is THE single isolation key (the v1 firmId/firm_id aliases are banned). Resolved at the two front doors only and bound into ctx; the data layer + Postgres RLS is the single enforcement point.

tenant_id.description: Canonical tenant isolation key. Every persisted row, deploy job, and artifact carries this; checked centrally via RLS.

session_id.description: The research session this context belongs to, if any.

deadline_ms.description: Wall-clock budget remaining for the whole request/session. Per-call timeouts derive as min(default, remaining). v1 had per-call timeouts but no aggregate budget.

kind.description: agent = a BYO external agent calling MCP; user = a human in the web UI; system = the platform itself (scheduler, worker).

id.description: Stable principal id (agent_id or user_id). Stable across credential rotation.
